Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

forestData 0.1.1

  • ntems("volume") fetches the NTEMS gross stem volume product.
  • ntems_species_volume() derives a species-weighted gross stem volume raster (NTEMS volume x summed per-species likelihood share); only the requested species layers are extracted from the large ZIP64 archive.
  • sbfi_species_volume() derives a species-weighted stand volume raster from the SBFI geodatabase (volume x summed species area share), reading only the tiles and columns needed.

forestData 0.1.0

Breaking changes

  • Exported functions and their arguments now use snake_case: casfriSpeciesLayers() is now casfri_species_layers(), and prepSpeciesLayers_SBFI() is now prep_species_layers_sbfi(); arguments studyArea, rasterToMatch, destDir, and destinationPath are now study_area, raster_to_match, dest_dir, and destination_path.
  • casfri_species_layers() now returns a SpatRaster (previously a RasterStack).
  • ecodistricts(), ecoprovinces(), ecoregions(), and ecozones() now return a SpatVector (previously sf).

Improvements

  • scanfi() returns a SpatRaster from SCANFI v2, with a type argument to select layers and a flavour argument for the public (NRCan) or private (Google Drive) source.
  • Data are downloaded and prepared with workflowtools and spatialutils instead of reproducible; national data are read lazily / prefiltered to the study area rather than loaded whole.
  • Dataset source URLs are centralized in R/urls.R.
  • Minimum R version is now 4.4.

Dependencies

  • remove raster, reproducible, SpaDES.tools, sp, archive, httr2, RCurl, XML, dplyr, glue, stringr, tidyterra, and stats;
  • add curl, spatialutils, and workflowtools.

forestData 0.0.2

  • drop support for R 4.1;
  • improved NTEMS data workflows and added more datasets (#3);

forestData 0.0.1

  • initial version
